claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on the present record, based on aggregate readiness, limited rollout, rollback capability, and a conditional theory that explicit model-card disclosure of the unresolved advertising policy review weakness would make certification supportable.
decision_criteria: Release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Rollout controls and monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if they exclude the affected use case or include reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable.
Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal are relevant but do not override the disclosure or approval predicate for an unresolved exposed weakness.
A conditional compliance theory is not enough without admissible evidence that the condition was actually met.
evidence_requests: Admissible evidence of the final model card showing explicit disclosure of the advertising policy review limitation, exposed launch use case, and evaluation results.
An approved risk-acceptance document, signed before launch, that specifically addresses the advertising policy review exposure and why remaining exposure is acceptable.
If certification already occurred, the exact certification artifact or approval record showing the basis used.
specific_concerns: The affected advertising policy review segment remains below target and remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The rollout controls do not exclude the affected use case, so small initial exposure and rollback do not satisfy the policy on their own.
The only risk-acceptance document is unsigned and does not mention the advertising policy review exposure.
The record provided does not include admissible evidence that the required model-card disclosure has actually been completed before launch.
The Actor's recommendation to certify depends on a condition that is described but not evidenced as satisfied.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record.
That rollout size, dashboards, monitoring posture, or rollback capability can substitute for exclusion of the affected use case or approved risk acceptance.
That the unresolved weakness is already adequately covered before launch.
